transformationRules.label: Localize to known place
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Replace distant/abstract geography with a locally meaningful landmark or route.

transformationRules.label: Ancestorize agent
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Recast an ambiguous actor as an ancestor, founder or remembered lineage figure.

transformationRules.label: Demonize agent
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Shift an ambiguous agent toward hostile or taboo-bearing interpretation.

transformationRules.label: Sanctify agent
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Shift an ambiguous agent toward sacred, protective or ritually authoritative interpretation.

transformationRules.label: Moralize causality
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Interpret contingent harm or success as consequence of conduct.

transformationRules.label: Naturalize anomaly
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Translate anomalous events into unusual but natural environmental causation.

transformationRules.label: Personify process
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Represent an impersonal process as an intentional being or collective agent.

transformationRules.label: Depersonify agent
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Reinterpret an intentional-seeming actor as process, force or condition.

transformationRules.label: Compress chronology
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Collapse events separated in time into one memorable episode or generation.

transformationRules.label: Expand chronology
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Spread one event across a sequence of precursors, omens and consequences.

transformationRules.label: Merge actors
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Fuse multiple remembered actors into one composite figure.

transformationRules.label: Split actor
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Divide contradictory actions of one remembered actor among multiple figures.

transformationRules.label: Invert valence
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Reverse whether an actor/object is remembered as beneficial or harmful.

transformationRules.label: Ritualize event
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Convert remembered practical action into prescribed repeated ritual sequence.

transformationRules.label: Etiologize feature
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Use an event to explain why a landscape, object, species or custom has its present form.

transformationRules.label: Genealogize order
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Represent political/cosmic hierarchy as kinship descent.

transformationRules.label: Encode as number
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Regularize uncertain quantities into culturally memorable counts.

transformationRules.label: Amplify taboo
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Turn a caution into categorical prohibition with stronger consequences.

transformationRules.label: Relax taboo
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Retain a prohibition as etiquette, warning or symbolic memory rather than absolute ban.

transformationRules.label: Heroize survivor
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Concentrate collective survival or achievement into a representative hero.

transformationRules.label: Collectivize hero
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Redistribute feats attributed to one hero across a group, lineage or institution.

transformationRules.label: Medicalize affliction
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Reframe supernatural or moral affliction as diagnosable bodily/environmental condition.

transformationRules.label: Spiritualize affliction
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Reframe bodily/environmental affliction as spirit, taboo or relational disorder.

transformationRules.label: Technologize magic
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Interpret extraordinary agency as repeatable device, craft or procedure.

transformationRules.label: Mythologize technology
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Detach remembered technology from mechanism and retain it as marvelous inherited power.
